final: WITH j AS (SELECT f.rating AS rating FROM film_category fc JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fc.film_id), c AS (SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY rating), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c), s AS (SELECT c.rating AS rating, c.cnt AS cnt, c.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM c CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.rating, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.rating
